title: Dex Share Follower Complication Null
body:
Hello, I'm running 2021.03.08 XDrip+, on a Samsung Galaxy Note 20 Ultra, and using a Ticwatch E W300 (Wear OS 2.26). I use the official Dexcom app to collect data and the share follower feature to get it into Xdrip. I have tried to see if this issue exists already, but it seems all threads are a couple years old.

I can get the Xdrip watchface to display BG readings, but when I try to send readings to the Skymaster watchface (as was recommended in the smartwatch guide) all I get is null (see picture).

I think there might be an issue with complications and Dex Share Followers, but I can't tell if it's been resolved or not (and if so, how).

Is it possible to be a Dex Share Follower and send the data via complications? 
![20210420_082438](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/12651921/115396360-e305f080-a1b2-11eb-9dba-3d64af6fa473.jpg)

If yes, please provide links.
If not, please close this issue.

I have: https://www.facebook.com/groups/xDripG5/permalink/5303342963072489

Arguably, it hasn't been long since posting, but I've scoured the Internet for a while now. I got a responses from one person in the FB thread, but it seems very few people use Dex Share Follower as the source. Most people are using their phones or their watches as the collector. I can find some issues from 2018 about followers and complications, but nothing as of late. 

In the SmartWatch guide by GregoryBel, the only null issue troubleshooting discussed is the calibration fix, which isn't possible as a follower (I get the "Got impossible slope calibration" error).
I've been researching this also for a wear os watch, and apparently it is not possible when xdrip is a follower, much to my frustration
